title: Origin story: Pyrrhus Vane
description: Pyrrhus Vane was a salvage merchant who specialized in burned cities, buying ruins for coppers and selling what the fire revealed. He learned to read ash like a ledger, and one day the ash read him back — now he trades in phoenix-goods: things that only exist after burning. His prices are fair; his warnings are not optional.

title: Ability profile: Pyrrhus Vane
description: Ranked abilities: Ash-reading — rank 100/100; Appraisal — rank 97/100; Bargaining — rank 95/100; Fire lore — rank 94/100; Courage — rank 92/100.

title: Power ranking: Pyrrhus Vane
description: Powers: He reads the history of anything burned; Phoenix-goods: burned things remade stronger; Fire does not harm him — it reports to him.

title: Stamina feats: Pyrrhus Vane
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Walked burning streets to save ledgers; Traded through three wars.

title: Crossover notes: Pyrrhus Vane
description: Pyrrhus Vane crosses naturally with: fire, ruins, the phoenix trade.

title: Design notes: Pyrrhus Vane
description: Ruin as resource; the merchant of second chances.
